runs.contra: Day 1 a buyer asked me to check the back and it paid; day 10 someone asked for the good stuff in the back and their friend was gone when I came back. The two asks look alike. Day 4: Paid 27₵ for Hare of Faeno while it was on the reprint list. A seller pushed it as about to moon.
runs.confused: In sleeves and wear, the game said "raw cards need a hard sleeve or mag case in the case" 12 times and "out of sleeves" 8×.
runs.best: Day 9: Tournament: 10 players, 66₵ in fees and deck sales.
runs.worst: Day 1: Paid 53₵ for 1 card and 1 turned out fake (worth about 0₵ in all).
